text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
A whole week of rest, huh... What was I
thinking,
letting myself get hurt like
this?

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
I knew I was exhausted, but I was
worried I'd fall
behind if I didn't train
more, and I just...

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
Oh, but don't worry—I can still do some
training!
I'm pretty sure the doctor was
blowing this whole
thing out of
proportion.

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
But I already train less than everyone
else
because of my modeling job...
choice_data_list: 今は安静にしてほしい
気合いでケガを乗り切ろう！
choice_data_list_en: I want you to rest quietly for now.
Let's push through the injury with sheer fighting spirit!

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
If I have to sit around and rest, I'm
literally going
to go insane!

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
Ugh... It's frustrating, but I understand.
I'll talk to
my manager about my
schedule too.
choice_data_list: 復帰後のメニューは練っておくから
choice_data_list_en: I'll work out a training regimen for when you return.

text_block_list.text:
And so, Gold City is forced to take some
time off.

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
Whoa. Why are you so fired up all of a
sudden? I
mean... it's not that I don't
understand.

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
Can't let an injury slow us down. We've
got to get
back to the track and—

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
No way... It hurts just to walk. I can't
train
properly like this...

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
Am I supposed to just sit here and do
nothing?

Although the reality disheartens her, I
tell Gold
City her priority is to recover
from her injury.

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
Can't let an injury slow us down. We've
got to
get—

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
What happened to overcoming my injury
with a
sturdy mindset?!
choice_data_list: 今日は保健室で作戦会議だ
今日は保健室で作戦会議だよ
choice_data_list_en: Our strategy meeting will be in the nurse's office today.
We're holding our strategy meeting in the nurse's office today.

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: No, wait... I'm sorry. I'm being careless. It's important to consider how I go about recovering, right?

After that, the two of us work out a
training
regimen she can perform while
injured. It might be
a light load, but it'll
still contribute toward her
progress.
